verdict.rationale: Appwrite Cloud documents per-project environments such as `staging`, each with its own resources and users, selected per request. Its hosted MCP server and headless CLI let agents operate on a project, which together approximate an isolated pre-production target for schema work. The Sites branch previews cover frontends only and are not credited for schema isolation. missing for 10: documented database/schema branching or ephemeral preview databases, an agent-driven workflow for testing schema changes in an environment, promotion or diffing of schema changes from staging to production, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can let an agent create and test schema changes in an isolated branch or preview environment before production

citations.quote: On Appwrite Cloud, a project can have environments, such as `staging`, each with its own resources and users
Using the MCP server, you can use applications such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and others to operate on your Appwrite project
The Appwrite CLI can be used in a non-interactive and headless manner. This is especially useful when you want to automate tasks on a continuous integration server.
